name: Echo Grotto
mechanic: emit sonar pings to briefly paint a pitch-black cave in sound while lurking beasts home in on your echoes
theme: a blind bat feeling its way through five lightless caverns toward daylight
tagline: You were born blind. Sound is your sight.
controls: arrows / WASD or hold to glide, tap or space to ping

name: Muster!
mechanic: herd a flock by pressure - sheep flee the dog, so you push from behind and bark to scatter them, scare wolves or enrage the ram
theme: a sheepdog working five sunlit fields against the clock
tagline: The flock has opinions. You have a whistle.
controls: mouse / touch or WASD / arrows to run, space or B to bark

name: Perihelion Post
mechanic: drag to launch a mail pod along a live-predicted trajectory, planetary gravity slingshots the flight and scarce thruster burns correct course into the delivery ring
theme: a solo courier drone running eight alien star systems on gravity alone
tagline: Aim once. Let the planets do the rest.
controls: mouse / touch drag to aim & launch, WASD / arrows or hold to thrust, space recalls the pod

name: Orbit Post
mechanic: drag-release slingshot throws of a mail pod bent by planetary gravity into a drop ring, with a live trajectory forecast and orbiting moon hazards
theme: an interplanetary courier service running five delivery runs between planets and moons
tagline: Gravity does the flying. You just let go at the right moment.
controls: mouse / touch drag or arrows + space

name: Night Junction
mechanic: flip track levers in real time to steer colour-coded steam trains into their matching stations, juggling occupied platforms and rear-end collisions
theme: a lone signalman running a storm-lit mountain junction box with three lanterns and an unfinished east line
tagline: Every lever is a promise. Keep it.
controls: mouse / touch tap levers or keys 1-3, P pause, R restart, M sound

name: Shadow Stage
mechanic: drag translucent shadow puppets across a lantern-lit screen and resize them by pushing them toward the flame, assembling each fable's silhouette against a live likeness meter before the audience's patience runs out
theme: a travelling shadow-puppet theatre performing seven paper fables behind one guttering oil lamp
tagline: Closer to the flame, bolder the shadow.
controls: mouse / touch drag shadows & gold resize knob, scroll or -/+ to resize, arrows nudge, Tab cycles, Enter presents, R restarts, M sound

name: Static Watch
mechanic: sweep an analogue dial to hunt drifting radio carriers by a falling beat-tone whistle and magic-eye glow, then hold the needle inside the lock window to log each voice
theme: the night wireless watch aboard a 1962 North Sea trawler, pulling ghost voices out of storm static
tagline: Somewhere in the static, someone is calling.
controls: mouse / touch drag or click the dial, arrows sweep, up/down fine trim, M mute, P pause, R restart

name: Chartwright
mechanic: glimpse a fog-bound island for a few seconds, then redraw its coastline freehand from memory - your ink is scored by how much of the true landmass it captures
theme: a ship's cartographer in a fogbound archipelago, redrawing charts lost overboard before landfall
tagline: The chart went overboard. Redraw it before landfall.
controls: mouse / touch to draw, Z undo, C clear, Space commits

name: Live Wire
mechanic: hold and drag a live spark along glowing circuit traces, balancing on the copper through sweeping rotor arms, timed capacitor flares and patrolling solder bugs without drifting off the trace
theme: a spark of current restoring five failing boards of a darkened mainframe on three fuses
controls: mouse / touch hold & drag, arrows or WASD nudge, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Anvil Song
mechanic: strike the hammer when a sweeping mark crosses the glowing zone while bellows-feeding heat and rationing one shared coal bed, then quench each blade true
theme: a storm-lit mountain smithy forging five blades over a single dying coal bed
controls: space / enter or tap to strike, hold B or the bellows button to reheat, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Hot Metal
mechanic: type the word carried by each slug of loose type before it reaches the wet page; mistyped keys break your pay chain, red slugs run fast for double pay, gilded slugs lift a smudge when set
theme: a midnight hand-printing shop where the type case has spilled and the press never stops until the dawn bell
tagline: Catch the words before the ink sets.
controls: keyboard letters; on-screen keys on touch; backspace or escape drops a held slug; buttons pause, mute, restart

name: Bad Penny
mechanic: load equal numbers of suspect coins on a two-pan balance, read each tilt as evidence that one counterfeit runs heavy or light, and accuse it before your limited weighings are spent
theme: an assayer's chamber in the royal mint, testing suspect batches under the magistrate's three wax seals
tagline: Every batch hides one lying coin. The scales never lie.
controls: mouse / touch tap coins (left pan, right pan, back), or arrows + A/D/S to place, Enter weighs, E accuses then H/L swears heavy or light, C clear, M sound, R restart

name: Escapement
mechanic: drag spare gears onto brass pegs to mesh a weight-driven wheel into the clock's crown, each mesh reversing the turn while tooth sizes trade speed for reach, rusted dead gears blocking the road
theme: the night shift inside a stopped clocktower, rebuilding six stripped gear trains floor by floor before midnight
controls: mouse / touch tap-to-place or 1-3 pick up, arrows aim, enter drops / lifts, x unmeshes, R resets floor, M sound, P pause

name: Glass Plate
mechanic: pan and zoom a spirit camera across a haunted ballroom, framing flickering apparitions and timing the shutter for when each spirit burns brightest, spending twelve glass plates to fill a five-print album before dawn
theme: a midnight spirit-photography séance in a derelict manor house
tagline: Frame what flickers. Shoot while it burns.
controls: mouse / touch drag to pan, click / tap or Space shoots, scroll / pinch or + − zooms, R restarts, P pauses, M sound
